text: Racing Force S.p.A. is listed on Euronext Growth Milan, and its own shareholder table shows SAYE S.p.A. as the largest shareholder with 49.27% of the share capital and the remaining 50.52% on the market.
short: SAYE S.p.A. holds 49.27% of listed Racing Force S.p.A.

source.name: Racing Force Group: Shareholders' Information
source.note: The table also shows treasury shares 0.22% and 'Market 50.52%'. Page undated; the date given is the day the page was opened. SAYE S.p.A.'s own ownership was not researched in this pass; no state or state-fund holder appears on the page.
